docs.title: SeatWise API
docs.intro: Versioned JSON endpoints for catalog, reservation, checkout, customer accounts, organizers, and administrators.
docs.authText: Protected endpoints use an HttpOnly Better Auth session cookie. Server-side role and ownership checks apply to every operation.
docs.idempotencyText: Checkout requires an Idempotency-Key. Repeating a key for the same customer cannot create another order or provider charge.
docs.errorsText: Errors include a stable code, safe message, request ID, and structured validation details when appropriate.
docs.paymentSimulatorText: Send one of these non-sensitive tokens as paymentToken: pm_success, pm_decline, pm_timeout, or pm_transient. Tokens control deterministic local outcomes; no card data is accepted.
